note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There were no contests (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8: 'There will be no contests for Castlederg Rural Council'). All sixteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2). The notice crosses the Clare and Clunahill rows; their members are filed by the other-names and abode columns and the 1952 and 1958 returns (see those divisions' notes). division inferred from the 5 June 1952 return (Clunahill: M. H. McCrea); the Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2 names the member as returned. The notice's two rows are crossed (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2, block images read): the Clare row prints surname 'McCrea', other names 'John', an abode and in column 5 'Michael H McCrea'; the Clunahill row prints 'Crockett', 'Michael Henry', an abode and 'John Crockett'. The other names on the Clunahill row are McCrea's, and McCrea sat for Clunahill in 1952, 1958 and 1961, so he is filed under Clunahill. Returned unopposed.
